data.name: NavigationHint
data.value: Default keys — A/D: objects | Q/E: 1 second | W/S: speed | F: speed 1x | Space: pause | Ctrl+Enter: take over

data.name: FreezeFrame
data.value: Freeze this frame and take over

data.name: ExactHelp
data.value: Freeze this frame, prepare for 3 seconds, then take over. No rewind. No score or replay will be saved.

data.name: SafeHelp
data.value: Rewind to before the objects, then prepare for 3 seconds. No score or replay will be saved.

data.name: BeatmapNotLoaded
data.value: The beatmap could not be loaded.

data.name: ViewerUnavailable
data.value: Takeover is unavailable for this replay viewer.

data.name: BeatmapMismatch
data.value: The loaded beatmap differs from the replay's beatmap. Restore the matching beatmap before taking over.

data.name: IncompleteReplay
data.value: A complete, non-empty replay is required.

data.name: WaitingForSeek
data.value: Waiting for replay seek to finish…

data.name: SeekBeforeTakeover
data.value: Seek back into the replay before taking over.

data.name: StandardOnly
data.value: Replay takeover currently supports osu!standard only.

data.name: UnknownMod
data.value: This replay contains an unknown mod.

data.name: AutomaticMod
data.value: {0} performs automatic gameplay. Keeping it would continue automation; removing it would change the replay's rules. Manual takeover is not supported.

data.name: BackwardSecondAction
data.value: Seek replay / practice backward one second

data.name: ForwardSecondAction
data.value: Seek replay / practice forward one second

data.name: ObjectStartOption
data.value: Start from selected object (ignore earlier objects)

data.name: ObjectRangeHelp
data.value: Object navigation selects a numbered object. Practice removes earlier objects, including unfinished sliders, and resets score/health for this range. No perfect hits are awarded. Arbitrary-time takeover still restores the original scene.

data.name: ObjectSelected
data.value: Object #{0} — earlier objects excluded in practice

data.name: PreviousMissHelp
data.value: Find the previous original replay combo-breaking miss, including slider breaks, and select its object at appearance.

data.name: PreviousIgnoredHelp
data.value: Find the previous original replay judgement that loses a combo increment without breaking combo, such as a dropped slider tail.

data.name: NoPreviousMiss
data.value: No earlier Miss in the original replay

data.name: NoPreviousIgnored
data.value: No earlier lost combo increment in the original replay

data.name: PreviousIgnoredAction
data.value: Replay / practice: previous original lost combo increment

data.name: NextMissHelp
data.value: Find the next original replay combo-breaking miss, including slider breaks, and select its object at appearance.

data.name: NextIgnoredHelp
data.value: Find an original replay judgement that loses a combo increment without breaking combo, such as a dropped slider tail.

data.name: NoNextMiss
data.value: No later Miss in the original replay

data.name: NoNextIgnored
data.value: No later lost combo increment in the original replay

data.name: NextIgnoredAction
data.value: Replay / practice: next original lost combo increment

data.name: AutoplayBaselineHelp
data.value: This is an automatically generated baseline, not your previous play. Takeover removes Autoplay and preserves the other mods. Only your input is used after preparation.

data.name: HoldObjectFocusHelp
data.value: While paused on an object, hold the left mouse button here to dim other objects. Release or move away to restore them. Does not alter skins, timing or judgements.
